title.zh: 月相 · 从地球看被照亮的那一半
title.en: Moon Phases · The Lit Half, Seen from Earth

desc.zh: 月亮永远有半边被太阳照亮；我们每晚看到多少，取决于它在轨道上跑到了哪里。
desc.en: Half the Moon is always lit by the Sun; how much of it we see each night depends on where it is on its orbit.
